note: Apply the rows with counted=true: action tag_answer (set the category of OPD document opd_doc_id), extract_tag (extract the text of OPD document opd_doc_id, tag it), fetch (fetch source_url, attach). verified=true with counted=false is the identity + wording tier (Jura: no date check), for a person or OPD to confirm. action=review rows are for a person. Every row's check_detail carries the route, identity and date class, the sha256 of the document read, the extractor and a quote of at most 200 characters.
source: results/repair/adapters/repair_<BODY>.tsv (python -m gegenprobe.repair.adapters.run --write); derived columns from python -m gegenprobe.census.corrected
precedence: Where two lists name the same affair, the adapter list wins over the older OCR candidate lists (results/repair/repair_<BODY>.tsv, action=ocr). The Bern lists (relink, fetch, review, begin_date) and the Valais retype_oral list have no adapter counterpart and stay as they are.
